description: This file is a shell script used for automating the creation of an appcast.xml file for software updates, specifically tailored for the OpenClaw project. It handles preparing release notes, verifying environment variables and files, finding the generate_appcast tool, and executing it with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: find_generate_appcast
methods.description: Locates the generate_appcast executable, either via command in PATH or within a specific directory in the project.
